- [CVE-2025-27828] Reflected XSS in the legacy chat component; CVSS 7.1 HIGH; not in KEV; description lists 10.2.0.0 through 10.2.0.4. Advisory: https://www.mitel.com/support/security-advisories/mitel-product-security-advisory-misa-2025-0003
